description.value:
Trigger You roll initiative and were Tracking at least one of your enemies in the encounter.

You entwine your arrows and spears with fey magic that signals the opening of the hunt. You can Interact to draw a ranged weapon or a weapon with the thrown trait, then you make a ranged Strike against a creature you were tracking. If the Strike hits, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] to your next Strike against it before the end of your first turn. If your hunting partner is in your wild link aura, the target is also off-guard to your hunting partner's first attack against it before the end of their first turn.
